dimensions.title: Coverage and behavior
requiredEvidence: Stable journey/group/catalog IDs; owner issue; contract version; exact baseline and candidate revisions.
Executable scenario and fixture checksum with actors, workspaces, schema, flags, entitlements, locale, client/provider versions.
Baseline/candidate raw outputs, persisted canonical state, relevant screenshots and explicit difference classification.
Independent reviewer, inspected artifacts, reproduced checks and unresolved findings; every required behavior classified.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Every journey. A catalog entry or source path alone cannot satisfy coverage; unknown requirements remain open.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Identity and sessions
requiredEvidence: Enabled password/social OAuth/SAML/OIDC, invitation and TOTP baseline/candidate scenarios.
Token/cookie renewal, expiry, single-use exchange, session-workspace binding, sign-out and revoked-session raw responses/state.
Real sign-in evidence for each configured provider, with CSRF/CORS/secure-cookie and impersonation restrictions.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Journeys that authenticate, create/renew/revoke credentials, bind membership, consume provider identity, or depend on session lifecycle. For other journeys record why their supplied authenticated actor removes identity scope.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Authorization
requiredEvidence: Same/foreign workspace probes for anonymous, invitee, member, admin, custom/restricted role, API-key, application and system principals where source entry supports them.
Raw authorized and denied read/write/subscription/export/file/metadata/tool responses plus persisted/effect state.
Field/row/object/settings/tool/share and delegated application-role intersection cases, including joins/search/export leaks.
Zero unauthorized information or effects among tested cases; enumerate combinations rather than claim universal proof.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Every boundary handling workspace data, metadata, credentials, files, shared records or external effects. Pure formatting cases may reuse upstream authorization evidence only with an explicit trusted-caller rationale.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Revocation and concurrency
requiredEvidence: Frozen effective-revocation timing for active clients, subscriptions, provider jobs and waiting workflow/agent runs.
Controlled interleavings for two edits, duplicate submits, delete versus relation/write, revoke versus read, retry versus cancel.
Raw event/provider counts, transaction state and eventual canonical sets proving declared invariants.
Source defects classified as correction requirements without silently normalizing them away.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Mutable authorization or concurrently accessed state. Document concurrency-free pure transformations explicitly; external callbacks and queued work always require relevant interleavings.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Data integrity
requiredEvidence: Consistent complete canonical sets for records, metadata, relations, timestamps, audit actors/history and files, with verified ID mapping.
File byte hashes, link/association integrity and declared null/missing/composite normalization.
Before/after mutation and crash/replay state, not only record counts; zero unexplained differences.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Every persisted-data or derived-data journey. Stateless requests record why no persisted set exists and compare serialized contract instead. Generated IDs may normalize only through a verified mapping.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Side effects and retries
requiredEvidence: Fault scenarios around database commit, queue acknowledgement, storage promotion, provider acceptance and event delivery.
Duplicate, reordered, replayed and lost-acknowledgement input; exact permitted outbound effect/usage/charge counts.
Persisted failure/recovery state and convergence after retry; explicit source retry policy per entry.
Webhook caught failures, upload conditional operations and isolated approval experiments assessed at their own boundaries.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Journeys that write, enqueue, notify, invoke providers, bill usage, or execute durable work. Pure reads may be inapplicable only after proving no side-effect consumer is involved.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Realtime and navigation
requiredEvidence: Direct URL, refresh, back/forward, cursor boundaries, multiple tabs/clients and stale-cache scenarios when UI exists.
Record/metadata/job subscriptions with mutation, reconnect, workspace switch and authorization changes.
Raw event shape/order/duplicate behavior and measured convergence against a frozen budget.
Listener/stream cleanup and absence of protected cached data after logout.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Journeys with routes, reactive/query consumers, paginated results or subscription/stream lifecycle. Backend-only one-shot commands may exclude navigation with explicit rationale; their pagination remains applicable.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Errors and recovery
requiredEvidence: Baseline/candidate validation errors, protocol status/error shape, persisted failure state and user-visible retry/cancel behavior.
Partial-success semantics for batches and transactional failure semantics for all-or-nothing paths.
Invalid input, absent resource, expired credentials/cursors, 401/403/429, timeout, malformed payload and restart cases where applicable.
Recovery state inspected after the fault; success response or source presence cannot replace state evidence.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Every journey has at least its actual input/resource/permission failure path. Provider-specific errors apply only to the providers and runtime boundaries the journey uses.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Accessibility and presentation
requiredEvidence: Rendered baseline/candidate screenshots at declared viewport/device/zoom and visual comparison of relevant states/artifacts.
Automated accessibility results with no new serious/critical violation; contrast checks explicitly enabled when relevant.
Keyboard, focus order, dialogs, error recovery, screen-reader and zoom scenarios executed independently.
Document/PDF preview and download visually inspected when the journey produces a visible artifact.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Journeys exposing UI or user-visible generated artifacts. Backend-only serialized contracts can be inapplicable with a reason; source CSS, builds and contrast-deferral presets are insufficient evidence.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Localization
requiredEvidence: Declared locale fixture matrix and message/catalog parity, with pseudo-locale and supported RTL examples.
Numbers, currency, dates, parsing, Unicode/casing, timezone/DST and text-visibility outputs where the journey handles them.
Fallback behavior for missing translations/provider language and valid localized support/documentation links.
Rendered RTL/long-text states and raw date/time values in both baseline and candidate.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: User-facing messages, locale-sensitive input/output, calendar/campaign times, translated metadata and generated agreements. Locale-independent identifiers or binary transport require an explicit inapplicability rationale.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Performance and cost
requiredEvidence: Frozen workload/dataset/provider/region/concurrency, latency/resource/throughput/cost budgets and normalization rules.
Matched result/effect/error totals across repeated source/candidate samples, reporting variance and p50/p95/p99 where applicable.
Cold and warm startup/query/provider behavior plus operations/model/file cost evidence.
Measured improvement requires a frozen metric or explicitly accepted baseline-defect correction.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Operationally significant UI queries, scans, bulk mutations, exports, installations, workflows, communications, models and storage. Tiny pure transformations may be excluded only with an explicit bounded-cost rationale.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: External consumers
requiredEvidence: Inventory of deployed/supported REST, GraphQL, MCP, SDK, CLI, Zapier, companion and installed-application consumer versions.
Captured requests/responses, schema generation, metadata/pagination/nested relation behavior and expected protocol errors.
Authentication/revocation and callback/input/output contract replay per actual consumer.
Compatibility/removal decision for every supported caller; no retired API before verified migration or accepted compatibility.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Public protocols and data/contracts used by supported consumers, provider callbacks or installed applications. Private implementation-only paths identify their consumers before declaring inapplicability.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Flags and entitlements
requiredEvidence: Captured deployed workspace flags and billing/enterprise/usage configuration; source defaults are not availability evidence.
Enabled, disabled, expired, revoked and exhausted-quota scenarios for each applicable capability.
Transitions during subscriptions, queued work, provider effects and concurrent quota reservations.
Delayed/duplicate/reversed grant/revoke events reconciled without stale authorization.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Any journey gated by feature flag, commercial entitlement, enterprise validity, quota, sender/model availability or configured provider. Unconditional flows must explicitly cite why no gate applies.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Operations
requiredEvidence: Intended deployment revision/region/version and real sign-in/provider operation with correlated readable logs and persisted state.
Alerting, reconciliation, restart, outage, credential/cursor renewal and failure-recovery drill evidence.
Dependency readiness and operator-access checks; health liveness alone cannot prove downstream operation.
Synthetic fixture cleanup and unresolved provider/deployment prerequisites named explicitly.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Every journey that crosses a deployment/provider/queue/storage/durable-runtime boundary. Pure domain computations cite the hosting entry point and may reuse its operational gate with rationale.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Migration and rollback
requiredEvidence: Frozen source/target revisions, mutable-dataset authority, consistent snapshot/checkpoint and complete reconciliation outputs.
Reversible identifier mappings and explicit nonportable credential/provider-cursor/subscription handling.
Faulted import/cutover steps replay safely; competing writers stopped or ordered reconciliation proved.
Rollback after acknowledged target writes preserves those writes and meets agreed RPO/RTO; recovered provider/jobs/audit state inspected.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Persisted state, identities, credentials, external subscriptions, files, schema and supported consumers whose ownership changes. Stateless UI layout may exclude data migration only with an explicit dependency argument.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Administrative controls
requiredEvidence: Authorized operator and nonoperator scenarios for health, flags/config, queue/maintenance, keys, usage limits and registrations.
Raw guarded backend responses and persisted effects, including backend invocation bypass attempts.
Dependency failure and empty health-result state; exact configured permissions/entitlement prerequisites.
Operator action correlated with audit and consumer behavior after control change.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: Journeys exposing server/workspace administrative controls or their equivalent direct backend operations. Ordinary record/user self-service flows document why they do not confer an operator control.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.

dimensions.title: Legal and support
requiredEvidence: Workspace/region/mode-bound DPA preview, processor entity, SCC state, template version and dates.
Cloud signing success and self-hosted signing rejection, persisted agreements, historical ordering, PDF bytes/hash and visual rendering.
Download authorization, missing signed-file null/error state and storage/database interruption behavior.
Support identity/workspace binding and localized documentation URLs/fallbacks.
dimensions.applicabilityRule: DPA/legal/support/documentation journeys and APIs/files they expose. Other data/CRM operations record explicit inapplicability; approval on generic backend gates cannot waive legal artifact inspection.
dimensions.detail: Acceptance contract derived from the maintained criteria map and local source. No acceptance gate was executed by this read-only inventory.
